packs.name: After hours
packs.author: Glowtune
packs.description: Violet neon and taxi-light blue, with two comets racing round the edge. One more track before dawn.
packs.toml:

name = "After hours"
author = "Glowtune"
version = 1

[colors]
mode = "gradient"

surface = "#ffffff18"

[glass]
blur = 36
opacity = 0.5
radius = 24

[font]
family = "Instrument Sans"
lyrics_family = "Bricolage Grotesque"

drift_speed = 1.6

packs.name: Cinema
packs.author: Glowtune
packs.description: Let the music video fill the room. Floating words, a quiet clock and a thin line of a dock.

packs.name: Poster
packs.author: Glowtune
packs.description: Big cut-out words on a printed cover, in ink and coral. Pasted up on the street.

packs.name: Slow Sunday
packs.author: Glowtune
packs.description: Soft silk, gentle karaoke and nowhere to rush.

packs.name: Night drive
packs.author: Glowtune
packs.description: Outline lettering over drifting cobalt and cherry light, with headlights racing round the edge.

packs.name: Liner notes
packs.author: Glowtune
packs.description: Just the words and the cover. No clock, no distractions.

packs.name: Front row
packs.author: Glowtune
packs.description: Bold words over the music video, with emoji bursting off the big lines. Bring the show home.
packs.sample: Hands up in the front row

packs.name: Constellation
packs.author: Glowtune
packs.description: Every sung word lights up as a star and joins the last, until the line draws its own constellation. The record spins and the edge fills with stars.
packs.sample: Join the dots back to you

packs.name: Rainy window
packs.author: Glowtune
packs.description: Water runs down over the cover and the words fall like rain. Wipe the glass clear with your mouse.

packs.name: Frosted
packs.author: Glowtune
packs.description: The cover fogs over like a cold window and flashes on the kick. Snow drifts round the edge.
packs.sample: Draw a heart in the glass

packs.name: Record store
packs.author: Glowtune
packs.description: The cover spins as the record on a tiled wall of colour, with dust in the light. Flip through the crates.
packs.sample: Flip it over to side B

packs.name: Planetarium
packs.author: Glowtune
packs.description: Words orbit the middle of the screen while a swell of light circles the edge. Lights out, look up.

packs.name: Basement show
packs.author: Glowtune
packs.description: Printed dots that swell on every kick, loud words, emoji and an equalizer round the edge. Turn it up.

packs.name: After credits
packs.author: Glowtune
packs.description: A field of dots in the song's colours, breathing slowly. Every kick drum sends a ring out across it, like the Glowtune film.

packs.name: Broken glass
packs.author: Glowtune
packs.description: Every letter flies in as sharp slivers and snaps together on the word, over a cover printed in dots. Glass breaking backwards.

packs.name: Price tag
packs.author: Glowtune
packs.description: The words hang on swinging white tags and roll like a counter onto every word. A shop window for your songs.

packs.name: Decoder
packs.author: Glowtune
packs.description: Each line waits as a row of glowing dots and decodes letter by letter as it's sung, over a field of dots that ripples on the beat.

packs.name: Wet paint
packs.author: Glowtune
packs.description: Words are brushed on in streaks of colour and run down the screen like wet paint, while water runs over the cover.
